title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)

messages.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: part:370010 – price basis from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your offer and your letter of 22 September.

Our orders with you for part:370010 rose from EUR 5.26 (po:4500013373-10) to EUR 5.84 (po:4500014427-10) between 2026-01-02 and 2026-09-18. That rise is already in our price. AS-14404 fell from 3182.6744 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06) to 3007.8019 (idx:AS-14404@2026-09), a change of -5.49%. PPI-C2431 fell from 131.9 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05) to 129.1 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08), a change of -2.12%.

We would prefer a fixed price over a surcharge clause. The attached packages offer you a longer volume commitment, which secures your planning. Could your pricing committee review them at its next meeting?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:370010 – price basis from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We also checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have reviewed the recent decreases in the AS-14404 and PPI-C2431 indices and adjusted our calculation accordingly. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. 

We appreciate your proposal for a 36-month contract, which provides valuable planning security for both sides. For a term of this duration, we must include the AS-14404 index clause to manage long-term material risks, allowing us to offer a unit price of €5.30. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. 

Our current offer provides a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.30 per unit, with a contract term of 36 months.

This offer stays valid for 30 days. We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: part:370010 – fixed price, 36-month package
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised offer and for taking the verified index data into account.

The forecast for part:370010 increased by 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

We still prefer a fixed price without a surcharge clause. A fixed price saves both sides the monthly recalculation and invoicing workload. The attached package commits 23700 pieces per year over 36 months on 60 days payment. That gives you the volume and planning security your team has said it wants to focus on.

Could you also tell us whether a cheaper variant of the peeled bar would meet our specification?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:370010 – fixed price, 36-month package
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. However, we cannot offer a fixed price for a 36-month term and must maintain the AS-14404 index clause to manage long-term material risks. 

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.10 per unit. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Our technical team will review your specifications to determine if a cheaper variant of the peeled bar is suitable. From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.24 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.05 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.03 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: part:370010 - revised fixed-price package, 36 months
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised offer and for reviewing a cheaper variant of the peeled bar.

We have moved our price a clear step towards you in the attached package. We keep the fixed price. It spares both sides the monthly surcharge recalculation and the invoice corrections. It also gives your team one stable figure to plan with.

The package commits 23700 pieces per year over 36 months, with payment at 60 days net.

Could you sign this package? We would also welcome the full details of the cheaper material grade and the wider tolerance so that our engineering can assess them.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:370010 - revised fixed-price package, 36 months
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for staying in touch with us. We are always keen to support your requirements with our reliable service and extensive product range.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. We offer a price of €4.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our offer stays valid for 7 days.

Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.00 per unit, with Zahlungsziel 60 days net and a contract term of 36 months.

We must maintain the AS-14404 index clause for a 36-month term, but could you quantify the administrative costs of the monthly recalculation you mentioned? Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.

Our technical department will forward the full specifications for the alternative material grade and wider tolerance for your review. From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.24 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.05 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.03 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Re: part:370010 - revised fixed-price package, 36 months

It is always a pleasure working with you, and we truly appreciate your business. As a reliable partner for high-quality steel products, our team remains at your disposal for all your supply needs from our extensive product range. We look forward to continuing our successful partnership.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
